title: Batch batch_1789474480 - 17 requests (13 new assets, 4 icon regens, 2 growth-group pairs)
plan: 3 new logging assets (Plantable Maple Sapling, Mature Pine Tree, Mature Poplar Tree) - icon generated individually using each item's reference asset as a style anchor, then a 3D model via Meshy image-to-3d
4 new ranching assets with a reference asset (100 Gallon Stock Tank - Empty, Suffolk Lamb, Tan Lamb, White Lamb) - same individual icon + reference approach, then Meshy image-to-3d

6 new ranching assets with no reference (Labrador Retriever, Calico Cat, Welsummer Chicken chick+adult, Black & White Billy Goat kid+adult) - batched into one contact sheet, then Meshy image-to-3d each
Welsummer Chicken and Black & White Billy Goat auto-assemble into 2-stage growth groups once both stages are done
3 icon-only regenerations (seed_potato, seed_sunflower, seed_wheat) matched in style to seed_corn - no 3D model touched

NOTE: 2 duplicate 'Regenerate Icon: seed_potato' requests detected in this batch (likely an accidental double-submit) - will generate the new icon once and mark both requests done rather than spend credits twice

FLAG: Labrador Retriever also requests rigging with rig_type=quadruped. Meshy's rig tool is built for humanoid/bipedal characters (t-pose, walk+run) and has no dedicated quadruped mode - the result may be poor. Approving this plan will still create the Labrador model; rigging it will be asked about separately once the model exists, not bundled into this approval.

cost.meshy: ~195cr (13 image-to-3d smart-topology generations @ 15cr each). Quadruped rigging for the Labrador, if pursued, would be a separate +5cr ask after the model exists.
